baseline_models.mechanism: The account follows a trace step by step, conveys consequential news in sequence, and submits that sequence to correspondence with what is fixed. Truth is therefore a narrative procedure, not only a label on content.

activation_trace.role: Following an أثر step after step supplies the account's reconstructive procedure.
Sequenced transmission supplies an ordered report rather than an isolated assertion.
Consequential news that arrives and is conveyed makes the object of narration knowledge-bearing.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the criterion named by bil-haqq.
Establishing and displaying truth makes the telling evidentiary as well as accurate.

changed_reading.after: God reconstructs a consequential report by following its sequence and making its correspondence to reality inspectable.

baseline_models.mechanism: Youthful freshness, heart-settling assent, and the Lord's gradual cultivation combine into a model of unfinished people entrusting themselves to formative care.

activation_trace.role: Youth and freshness mark the group as still in formation rather than already established authorities.
Assent in which the heart settles supplies the inward act of belief.
Security and trust add reliance, not bare proposition, to their believing.
Repair, nurture, and completion stage by stage make their Lord the agent of continuing formation.

changed_reading.before: Some young men believed in their Lord.
changed_reading.after: A still-forming cohort placed settled trust in the one who would cultivate and complete them by stages.

baseline_models.mechanism: The adjacent chain of Lord, increase, and guidance reads as cultivation whose product is an enlarged course and capacity, with the packet's R-B-W split sharpening growth already present in R-B-B nurture.

activation_trace.role: Gradual repair and nurture supply the governing process.
The distinct R-B-W target's feeding and growth image sharpens cultivation without replacing the R-B-B sense.
Increase and internal growth make guidance cumulative rather than static.
Direction, course, and manner identify what is being progressively enlarged.

changed_reading.before: After they believed, God gave them more guidance.
changed_reading.after: Their initial trust entered a continuing cultivation in which their capacity and course were progressively enlarged.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their request that a sound course be prepared becomes, in the focus ayah, an answered trajectory: guidance is added through formation rather than delivered as one instruction.

activation_trace.role: Preparation and repair for an affair supply the requested enabling condition.
Hitting the sound face of an affair and acting well specify the practical rectitude requested.
Staged cultivation identifies how the requested preparation can unfold.
Increase turns the requested rectitude into an ongoing answer.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies the answer's content.

structural_cues: 18:10 places the request for prepared rashad before 18:13 reports added huda.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a request followed by an increase; I read the later clause as an answer trajectory. A live alternative is that the increase is a separate gift not causally tied to the prayer.

changed_reading.before: They requested right direction and later received guidance.
changed_reading.after: Their prayer opens a developmental answer in which right action is prepared by progressively added orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Added guidance becomes an embodied causal chain: hearts are fastened, the youths rise into the matter, and stabilized conviction becomes public speech.

activation_trace.role: Guidance as course supplies the focus capacity later enacted.
Fastening and stabilizing the heart supplies the internal reinforcement.
The heart locates the reinforcement in the center of conviction.
Rising with resolve into an affair converts inward stability into action.

structural_cues: 18:14 orders the actions as fastening hearts, standing, then speaking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered actions; I infer that heart-binding is an operational form of the increase in guidance. It could instead be a later aid distinct from the increase reported in 18:13.

changed_reading.before: Their guidance was increased as inward understanding.
changed_reading.after: Their guidance was increased as stabilizing courage that could carry conviction into a public stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The youths' demand for a manifest, compelling warrant and their naming of fabrication establish a local evidentiary ethic. The divine report bil-haqq answers that ethic by showing rather than merely asserting truth.

activation_trace.role: Establishing and displaying truth makes the divine report a warranted presentation.
Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the surrounding failure of unsupported speech.
A compelling proof supplies the warrant the youths demand of a public claim.
Disclosure by speech or sign requires the warrant to be intelligible and manifest.
Fabricated falsehood names the alternative to warranted reporting.

structural_cues: 18:5 moves from lack of knowledge to mouth-speech and lie; 18:15 counters with a demand for clear authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the epistemic contrast; I take the youths' demand as the local standard echoed by bil-haqq. The simpler alternative is that bil-haqq only certifies factual accuracy.

changed_reading.before: The account is sincere rather than false.
changed_reading.after: The account performs the evidentiary discipline the youths themselves demand: claims are made manifest with warrant, not manufactured by speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance expands from inward direction into a protected spatial course: mercy opens around them, the sun veers and passes to either side, and the explicit guide/led clause names this managed geometry as a sign.

activation_trace.role: Guidance as direction and course supplies the focus anchor for a spatial realization.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply mercy's expansion into a usable field.
Inclining and turning aside supplies one boundary movement around the sleepers.
Crossing a place toward one side supplies the paired boundary movement.
A spacious interval supplies the protected interior in which the course operates.
The repeated guide and rightly-led forms explicitly frame the scene with direction toward the true road.

structural_cues: 18:17 pairs sunrise and sunset movements around an open cave space, then immediately contrasts divine guidance and misguidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies geometry followed by an explicit guidance clause; I read the arrangement as guidance enacted through environment. A live alternative treats the geometry only as preservation under mercy.

changed_reading.before: God increased their inward religious direction.
changed_reading.after: God's guidance also appears as a hospitable geometry that steers exposure, shelter, and position around them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The awakened group converts guidance into a compact survival protocol: delegate one member, inspect, select what is pure and fitting, move inconspicuously, and prevent detection.

activation_trace.role: Guidance as manner and course anchors the later sequence as practical orientation.
The repeated sending root links divine arousal of the group with their delegated dispatch of one member.
Directing sight or insight toward an object supplies deliberate assessment.
Purity and soundness supply the criterion for selecting food.
Fineness, smallness, and concealment supply the mission's low visibility.
Subtle knowledge and perceptiveness supply control over what others notice.

structural_cues: 18:19 embeds a delegated errand inside the divine awakening and sequences inspection, selection, concealment, and non-disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered commands; I group them as a practical realization of increased guidance. They could also be ordinary survival skills acquired independently of that increase.

changed_reading.before: The added guidance concerns belief and right doctrine.
changed_reading.after: The added guidance includes distributed judgment: how a vulnerable group observes, chooses, delegates, and remains unseen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The truthful report draws an epistemic boundary. Hidden history is uncovered so that a promise can be known as true, while later numerical claims remain stone-throws into the unseen and objects of restricted dispute.

activation_trace.role: Establishing and displaying truth anchors the report as disclosure.
Coming upon what was hidden supplies the event's conversion into public evidence.
A promise that opens hope supplies the future claim the event verifies.
Fixed correspondence with reality explicitly qualifies the promise as true.
Speaking by conjecture about the unseen supplies the report's epistemic counterexample.
What is screened from sight marks the domain in which counting claims lack access.
Sharp verbal disputation supplies the social form taken by unsupported uncertainty.

structural_cues: 18:21 makes discovery lead to knowledge that the promise is true; 18:22 follows with competing counts, rajman bil-ghayb, and a limit on dispute.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies verified promise followed by bounded speculation; I infer that the focus report sorts demonstrative significance from inaccessible detail. It may instead guarantee every historical detail without foregrounding this boundary.

changed_reading.before: The report supplies a correct historical account.
changed_reading.after: The report discloses enough hidden history to verify the promised awakening while refusing to convert inaccessible detail into confident knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance remains iterative after the story: forgetting triggers remembrance, and guidance is sought toward a nearer, sounder course. Increase therefore names corrigible proximity, not completed possession.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth anchor guidance as capable of further degree.
Recovering what was absent after forgetting supplies the corrective return.
Loss of remembrance supplies the lapse that guidance must absorb rather than deny.
Direction toward road and truth supplies the renewed movement.
Nearness rather than distance makes the desired improvement gradable.
Sound practical judgment specifies the nearer destination.

structural_cues: 18:24 sequences forgetting, remembering the Lord, and seeking guidance to something nearer in rashad.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a correction loop and comparative nearness; I read these as the open-ended grammar of added guidance. The command may address only a later lapse without describing the youths' increase.

changed_reading.before: The youths received a completed increment of guidance.
changed_reading.after: Added guidance is an ongoing capacity to recover from lapse and move toward a nearer, sounder course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's distinct F-T-W mapped target beside the ordinary F-T-Y youth sense. It remains valid because both cited occurrences carry packet root ف ت ي while their mapped identities stay explicit; downstream prose should present it only as a controlled root echo, never as an equation of youth with legal opinion.

activation_trace.role: The F-T-Y target supplies the youths as fresh, still-forming subjects of the report.
The separate F-T-W target supplies seeking a clarifying ruling about those subjects, which the command withholds.

changed_reading.before: The youths are simply the actors whose story is told.
changed_reading.after: Their label faintly answers the later ban on seeking a fatwa about them: divine reporting, not external adjudication, governs access to their case.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The exact Z-Y-D repetition is firm, but its interpretive contrast is surprising: qualitative guidance and quantitative years are different objects. Keep it as a lexical counterpoint about kinds of increase, not a claim that elapsed duration caused their guidance.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth attach in the focus to guidance as a qualitative object.
The same increase branch attaches later to a numerical addition in elapsed years.
The number nine fixes the later increase within explicit counting.

changed_reading.before: God increased their guidance, and separately the verse adds nine years.
changed_reading.after: The surah sets qualitative increase in orientation beside quantitative increase in duration, foregrounding two very different measures of what grew.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it uses the packet's separate Z-W-D target under focus root ز ي د. The refuge and delegated errand keep the material analogy anchored; render it as a flicker of provisioning, not as a lexical replacement for increased.

activation_trace.role: The distinct Z-W-D target supplies carried provision for movement as an exploratory image of what guidance provides.
Direction toward a road or truth makes guidance the fitting content of such provision.
Joining a place that gathers and shelters supplies the displacement-and-refuge setting.
Money carried on the delegated journey supplies a concrete provisioning analogue.

changed_reading.before: God gave them a larger amount of guidance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, guidance also behaves like carried provision that equips a displaced group for refuge, passage, and a risky errand.

strongest_changes: Bil-haqq shifted from a sincerity label to a traceable, warrant-bearing mode of reconstruction.
Added guidance shifted from more information to staged cultivation, heart-stabilization, and public action.
The cave sequence made guidance spatial and tactical through shelter geometry, delegation, discernment, and concealment.
The later discovery and counting dispute made the report verify the promise while policing the boundary between disclosure and conjecture.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated roots turned the focus clause into a process: requested rashad becomes added huda, heart-binding becomes a stand, and the same increase root later contrasts guidance with counted duration. Split mapped roots also exposed contained echoes of growth, fatwa, and travel provision.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal links from prayer, heart-binding, environmental arrangement, and practical tactics to the increase in guidance are reader-supplied arrows rather than explicit identifications.
The F-T-Y/F-T-W and Z-Y-D/Z-W-D readings depend on split mapped targets and should remain controlled resonances.
The environmental reading may describe preservation under mercy rather than guidance itself, despite the immediate guidance clause.
